firmware.title: CPH2771_16.0.9.401(EX01) is available
firmware.description:
New version: CPH2771_16.0.9.401(EX01)Home screen & Lock screen

• A wider selection of custom fingerprint icons and animations is now available. You can find this feature in "Settings - Home screen, Lock screen & style - More - Fingerprint animation".

• Improves transition animations when opening and switching apps in "Recent Tasks," resulting in a faster, more fluid multitasking experience.

Games

• You can now use the equalizer to fine-tune game sound effects, crafting a unique sound profile and enjoying a truly personalized gaming audio experience. You can find this feature in "Game Assistant - Tools - Sound boost - Equalizer".

• Improves the "Sound boost" feature to accommodate more games and deliver custom audio enhancements (such as amplifying footsteps, deepening environmental effects, or sharpening vocals) for even greater sound detail during gameplay.

Device Connect

• You can now lock your PC remotely with a single tap. After your phone connects to your PC remotely, you can unlock your PC directly from the phone without entering your PC's password.

Security & privacy

• You can now add a backup face for device unlocking, so you can access your device even if you're wearing glasses or makeup. You can find this feature in "Settings - Security & privacy - Device unlock - Face & fingerprint unlock - Face - Add backup face".

• Integrates the July 2026 Android security patch to enhance system security.

Please do not turn off your device while the update is installing. During installation you cannot use your device at all, even to dial 9-1-1
